4014.title: Project defaults lose to tab preferences
4014.rootCauseOneLine: Stored tab provider preferences take precedence over arriving project defaults in the new-thread hook.
4014.proposedFix: Honor project initialization until explicit picker changes, with project reset and reasoning reconciliation coverage.
4014.caveats: Hook-level reproduction; no packaged desktop or live-provider verification. Fix stopped because existing regression tests failed.
